signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

news.title: Solving the delivery problem: Dyno Therapeutics on AI-designed capsids and the gene therapy frontier

bullets: Lead development of Dyno’s external-facing AI platforms (e.g., design.dynotx.com )
Develop field-relevant benchmarks for agentic tasks in biological design
Build and improve AI-driven workflows that integrate models, data systems, and experimental feedback
Translate scientific and clinical questions into production-ready systems, including APIs, pipelines, and user-facing tools
Work directly with wet lab teams to ensure that computational outputs are tested and refined through experiments
